boundary_rationale: A setumah marks the preceding span's own close at oshb:Jer.39.14 (single-witness WLC; weak, tier-3 corroboration), immediately before a fresh act of divine speech to Jeremiah opens this one, וְאֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר יְהוָ֑ה בִּֽהְיֹת֣וֹ עָצ֔וּר בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר (oshb:Jer.39.15, byte), matching “Now Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,” (web:Jer.39.15) — a prepositional addressee phrase, וְאֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ (oshb:Jer.39.15, byte), fronted ahead of the verb, with the clause's own subject standing as the word-of-YHWH phrase itself, דְבַר יְהוָ֑ה (oshb:Jer.39.15, byte); of the book's three counted word-event shapes (the vayehi-debar-YHWH onset at 21 verses, the hadavar-asher-hayah superscription at 11, and the OAN/topical header at 4), only the first opens verb-first, so this verse's fronted phrase sets it apart from that one shape rather than from a two-member contrast. The message directs Jeremiah to Ebedmelech by name, matching “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying,” (web:Jer.39.16), opening on Yahweh's own title stack, כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל (oshb:Jer.39.16, byte), matching “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says:” (web:Jer.39.16) — Yahweh's own formula, relayed through Jeremiah's commanded speech to Ebedmelech (a ketiv/qere note also sits later in this same verse, present but not engaged by this quotation), promising deliverance rather than harm; the span and the part both close on that promise through verse 18, matching “For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” (web:Jer.39.18), closing on Yahweh's own attribution formula, where a setumah marks the closing verse, oshb:Jer.39.18 (single-witness WLC; weak, tier-3 corroboration).
